parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of ABS plastic, typically circular and slightly convex for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that, when pressed, releases the liquid or foam from the dispenser through the outlet.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is a small nozzle-like component located at the top of the dispenser, made of polypropylene.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of liquid or foam outward when the lid is pressed, ensuring controlled dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place but allows fluid to pass through when pressure is applied to the lid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of polyethylene, designed to hold the liquid or foam.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid or foam and provides structural support for the lid and outlier components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the stable base of the dispenser.
